rapport_notes: Warm, personable tone; active listening and customer acknowledgment throughout; friendly but not over-familiar; good pacing and natural rhythm.
process_discipline_notes: Rep asked 'did you have any other questions for me' near the end without holding silence afterward — immediately filled the space when the customer said no questions.

evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep opens with 'do you have a moment to kind of walk through that?' but provides no time-boxed framing or promise of an accurate quote in return; no explicit quid pro quo trade.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Rep asks 'are there any just questions off the top that I can just make sure that I answer for you on this call' — but this comes AFTER asking about move details. Customer responds 'I don't think so' and confirms he is confident in the process. This is asked after probing has begun, not before.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer does not raise concerns; he explicitly states 'I don't think I have any questions necessarily. I think I'm pretty confident.' Rep does not probe deeper on this or ask clarifying follow-ups. When logistics details emerge (box count, item list), rep confirms and moves on without true two-layer follow-up. No concern raised = N/A full credit under rubric exception, but the agenda line itself was asked after probing.
evidence_quotes.sheet1_careful_with: Never asked 'What items do you need us to be most careful with?' No damage/carefulness concern raised by customer, and rep never raised it as a differentiator.
evidence_quotes.sheet2_whos_coming: Never mentioned 'Meet Your Mover,' who the crew lead is, or how the customer will know their movers. Not covered anywhere in the call.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee: Never mentioned on-time guarantee or any time-commitment differentiator beyond the specific move window discussed.
evidence_quotes.communication: Never mentioned day-before call, named crew lead, inbox updates, or communication protocol beyond the logistics discussion.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Rep anchors: 'typically our... well, we have a square footage like 1300 square foot, two bedroom. Normally that takes anywhere from five to seven hours' and personalizes to customer's situation (fifth floor apartment to house, less elevator hassle, move from five-story to one-story). Full anchor and personalization present.
evidence_quotes.estimate_is_a_window: Rep states: 'If it goes less than that with us. You only pay for the time you use so you don't pay, you don't pay based off of the estimate, you pay just based off of time use. So, if we do only use three to four hours, then that's all you're paying for anyway.'
evidence_quotes.beats_it_pay_less: Same quote above covers this — 'if we do only use three to four hours, then that's all you're paying for' implicitly covers that paying is based on actual time used.
evidence_quotes.self_prep_tip: Never mentioned that customer prep work (packing, pre-boxing) comes off the bill.
evidence_quotes.does_that_feel_fair_then_silence: Rep never uses this closing line. Near end, rep asks 'Did you have any like other just your questions for me that I can answer' — but does not hold silence and immediately restates information.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock: Never mentioned 'your rate locks when you book' or any rate-lock language.
evidence_quotes.close_explicit_ask: Call ends with 'Thank you so much for answering my call William and we'll roll with this and then of course if you think of anything or something comes up just keep us in the loop but I have all the information and we look forward to seeing you on the eleventh.' No explicit ask like 'would you like our help with your move?' — the booking appears to have already occurred (customer says 'I think 1:30 will work') but rep never formally closes or confirms the booking.

top_strength: Chauntelle built strong rapport, asked clarifying logistical questions methodically, and personalized the time estimate to the customer's specific move characteristics (floor change, sectional couch, box count).
coaching_note: Stage 2 differentiators (On-Time Guarantee, Communication, Meet Your Mover, and damage coverage) were never delivered — none of these four appeared anywhere in the call; this is the critical gap to close on the next call.
